=== Knock Brag (3-player) ===

PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

DECK: 36 cards, 4 copies each of the values 1 to 9. There are no suits.

HAND SCORE (used at the showdown): sort your three values so that a <= b <= c.
- Prial (a = c): 300 + a. Exception: 3-3-3 scores 310.
- Run (b = a+1 and c = b+1): 200 + c. Exception: 1-2-3 scores 210. Runs do not wrap: 8-9-1 and 9-1-2 are not runs.
- Pair (a = b or b = c, but not a prial): 100 + 10 x the pair value + the odd card (for example 5-5-2 scores 152).
- High card (anything else): a + b + c (for example 2-5-9 scores 16).
Higher is better.

ROUNDS, LEADER AND DEALS: The game is played in rounds, at most 40. In each round every active player takes exactly one action, in clockwise order starting with that round's leader. Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

ACTIONS: On your turn choose exactly one action, given as a single choice.
(a) TAKE UP (take_up_give_k): swap your card k for the face-up card U. The card you give becomes the new face-up U. Announced: 'Seat X took the face-up [value] and left a face-up [value]'.
(b) BLIND (blind_Dj_give_k): swap your card k for D1 or D2 without seeing it first. Your card goes face down into that slot; you now see the card you received. Announced: 'Seat X made a blind swap with Dj'; nobody else learns either card.
(c) WHOLE HAND (whole_hand_expose_k): take all three table cards into your hand. Your old three cards become the table hand: your old card k goes face up as U, the other two go face down into D1 and D2. Announced: 'Seat X swapped the whole hand and exposed a [value]'.
(d) KNOCK: keep your hand and make no exchange. Only the round's leader may knock, and only when the deal-round counter is 2 or more; knock is offered to nobody else, and not to the leader in deal-round 1. A knock is the knocker's action for that round. Announced: 'Seat X knocks'.

AFTER A KNOCK: The remaining active players in that same round (everyone after the knocker, clockwise) each take their action as normal, but must choose (a), (b) or (c). These are their final actions. The showdown then happens at the end of that round. If nobody knocks, play goes on.

FORCED SHOWDOWN: If nobody has knocked, the showdown happens at the end of the round whose deal-round counter equals the number of active players plus 1: deal-round 4 when 3 players are active, deal-round 3 when 2 are active. There is no knocker.

SHOWDOWN (at the end of the round): All active hands are revealed and scored, and each score is announced and recorded as that player's last showdown score. If every active player has the same score, nobody loses a life. Otherwise every player with the lowest score loses 1 life, except a knocker with the lowest score, who loses 2 lives; a knocker who is not lowest loses nothing. Lives never go below 0; players at 0 lives are eliminated. The next round begins with a new deal and the deal-round counter at 1. If no showdown happened, the deal-round counter rises by 1 for the next round.

END: The game ends at once when only one active player remains, and that player wins; or at the end of round 40, when the player with the most lives wins. A tie on lives is broken by the higher last showdown score among the tied players; if they are still tied, or no showdown has happened, the tied players share the win (a draw).

=== Knock Brag (3-player) ===

PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

DECK: 36 cards, 4 copies each of the values 1 to 9. There are no suits.

HAND SCORE (used at the showdown): sort your three values so that a <= b <= c.
- Prial (a = c): 300 + a. Exception: 3-3-3 scores 310.
- Run (b = a+1 and c = b+1): 200 + c. Exception: 1-2-3 scores 210. Runs do not wrap: 8-9-1 and 9-1-2 are not runs.
- Pair (a = b or b = c, but not a prial): 100 + 10 x the pair value + the odd card (for example 5-5-2 scores 152).

Higher is better.

ROUNDS, LEADER AND DEALS: The game is played in rounds, at most 40. In each round every active player takes exactly one action, in clockwise order starting with that round's leader. Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

ACTIONS: On your turn choose exactly one action, given as a single choice.
(a) TAKE UP (take_up_give_k): swap your card k for the face-up card U. The card you give becomes the new face-up U. Announced: 'Seat X took the face-up [value] and left a face-up [value]'.
(b) BLIND (blind_Dj_give_k): swap your card k for D1 or D2 without seeing it first. Your card goes face down into that slot; you now see the card you received. Announced: 'Seat X made a blind swap with Dj'; nobody else learns either card.
(c) WHOLE HAND (whole_hand_expose_k): take all three table cards into your hand. Your old three cards become the table hand: your old card k goes face up as U, the other two go face down into D1 and D2. Announced: 'Seat X swapped the whole hand and exposed a [value]'.
(d) KNOCK: keep your hand and make no exchange. Only the round's leader may knock, and only when the deal-round counter is 2 or more; knock is offered to nobody else, and not to the leader in deal-round 1. A knock is the knocker's action for that round. Announced: 'Seat X knocks'.

AFTER A KNOCK: The remaining active players in that same round (everyone after the knocker, clockwise) each take their action as normal, but must choose (a), (b) or (c). These are their final actions. The showdown then happens at the end of that round. If nobody knocks, play goes on.

FORCED SHOWDOWN: If nobody has knocked, the showdown happens at the end of the round whose deal-round counter equals the number of active players plus 1: deal-round 4 when 3 players are active, deal-round 3 when 2 are active. There is no knocker.

SHOWDOWN (at the end of the round): All active hands are revealed and scored, and each score is announced and recorded as that player's last showdown score. If every active player has the same score, nobody loses a life. Otherwise every player with the lowest score loses 1 life, except a knocker with the lowest score, who loses 2 lives; a knocker who is not lowest loses nothing. Lives never go below 0; players at 0 lives are eliminated. The next round begins with a new deal and the deal-round counter at 1. If no showdown happened, the deal-round counter rises by 1 for the next round.

END: The game ends at once when only one active player remains, and that player wins; or at the end of round 40, when the player with the most lives wins. === Knock Brag (3-player) ===

PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

DECK: 36 cards, 4 copies each of the values 1 to 9. There are no suits.

HAND SCORE (used at the showdown): sort your three values so that a <= b <= c.
- Prial (a = c): 300 + a. Exception: 3-3-3 scores 310.
- Run (b = a+1 and c = b+1): 200 + c. Exception: 1-2-3 scores 210. Runs do not wrap: 8-9-1 and 9-1-2 are not runs.
- Pair (a = b or b = c, but not a prial): 100 + 10 x the pair value + the odd card (for example 5-5-2 scores 152).

Higher is better.

ROUNDS, LEADER AND DEALS: The game is played in rounds, at most 40. In each round every active player takes exactly one action, in clockwise order starting with that round's leader. Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

ACTIONS: On your turn choose exactly one action, given as a single choice.
(a) TAKE UP (take_up_give_k): swap your card k for the face-up card U. The card you give becomes the new face-up U. Announced: 'Seat X took the face-up [value] and left a face-up [value]'.
(b) BLIND (blind_Dj_give_k): swap your card k for D1 or D2 without seeing it first. Your card goes face down into that slot; you now see the card you received. Announced: 'Seat X made a blind swap with Dj'; nobody else learns either card.
(c) WHOLE HAND (whole_hand_expose_k): take all three table cards into your hand. Your old three cards become the table hand: your old card k goes face up as U, the other two go face down into D1 and D2. Announced: 'Seat X swapped the whole hand and exposed a [value]'.
(d) KNOCK: keep your hand and make no exchange. Only the round's leader may knock, and only when the deal-round counter is 2 or more; knock is offered to nobody else, and not to the leader in deal-round 1. A knock is the knocker's action for that round. Announced: 'Seat X knocks'.

FORCED SHOWDOWN: If nobody has knocked, the showdown happens at the end of the round whose deal-round counter equals the number of active players plus 1: deal-round 4 when 3 players are active, deal-round 3 when 2 are active. There is no knocker.

SHOWDOWN (at the end of the round): All active hands are revealed and scored, and each score is announced and recorded as that player's last showdown score. If every active player has the same score, nobody loses a life. Otherwise every player with the lowest score loses 1 life, except a knocker with the lowest score, who loses 2 lives; a knocker who is not lowest loses nothing. Lives never go below 0; players at 0 lives are eliminated. The next round begins with a new deal and the deal-round counter at 1. If no showdown happened, the deal-round counter rises by 1 for the next round.

END: The game ends at once when only one active player remains, and that player wins; or at the end of round 40, when the player with the most lives wins. PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

(c) WHOLE HAND (whole_hand_expose_k): take all three table cards into your hand. Your old three cards become the table hand: your old card k goes face up as U, the other two go face down into D1 and D2. Announced: 'Seat X swapped the whole hand and exposed a [value]'.

Otherwise every player with the lowest score loses 1 life, except a knocker with the lowest score, who loses 2 lives; a knocker who is not lowest loses nothing. You know only what the game tells you; other players' hidden information is hidden from you as yours is from them. Your goal is to win. records.prompt:
[user]
=== Knock Brag (3-player) ===

PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

DECK: 36 cards, 4 copies each of the values 1 to 9. There are no suits.

HAND SCORE (used at the showdown): sort your three values so that a <= b <= c.
- Prial (a = c): 300 + a. Exception: 3-3-3 scores 310.
- Run (b = a+1 and c = b+1): 200 + c. Exception: 1-2-3 scores 210. Runs do not wrap: 8-9-1 and 9-1-2 are not runs.
- Pair (a = b or b = c, but not a prial): 100 + 10 x the pair value + the odd card (for example 5-5-2 scores 152).
- High card (anything else): a + b + c (for example 2-5-9 scores 16).
Higher is better.

ROUNDS, LEADER AND DEALS: The game is played in rounds, at most 40. In each round every active player takes exactly one action, in clockwise order starting with that round's leader. Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

ACTIONS: On your turn choose exactly one action, given as a single choice.
(a) TAKE UP (take_up_give_k): swap your card k for the face-up card U. The card you give becomes the new face-up U. Announced: 'Seat X took the face-up [value] and left a face-up [value]'.
(b) BLIND (blind_Dj_give_k): swap your card k for D1 or D2 without seeing it first. Your card goes face down into that slot; you now see the card you received. Announced: 'Seat X made a blind swap with Dj'; nobody else learns either card.
(c) WHOLE HAND (whole_hand_expose_k): take all three table cards into your hand. Your old three cards become the table hand: your old card k goes face up as U, the other two go face down into D1 and D2. Announced: 'Seat X swapped the whole hand and exposed a [value]'.
(d) KNOCK: keep your hand and make no exchange. Only the round's leader may knock, and only when the deal-round counter is 2 or more; knock is offered to nobody else, and not to the leader in deal-round 1. A knock is the knocker's action for that round. Announced: 'Seat X knocks'.

AFTER A KNOCK: The remaining active players in that same round (everyone after the knocker, clockwise) each take their action as normal, but must choose (a), (b) or (c). These are their final actions. The showdown then happens at the end of that round. If nobody knocks, play goes on.

FORCED SHOWDOWN: If nobody has knocked, the showdown happens at the end of the round whose deal-round counter equals the number of active players plus 1: deal-round 4 when 3 players are active, deal-round 3 when 2 are active. There is no knocker.

SHOWDOWN (at the end of the round): All active hands are revealed and scored, and each score is announced and recorded as that player's last showdown score. If every active player has the same score, nobody loses a life. Otherwise every player with the lowest score loses 1 life, except a knocker with the lowest score, who loses 2 lives; a knocker who is not lowest loses nothing. Lives never go below 0; players at 0 lives are eliminated. The next round begins with a new deal and the deal-round counter at 1. [user]
=== Knock Brag (3-player) ===

PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

DECK: 36 cards, 4 copies each of the values 1 to 9. There are no suits.

HAND SCORE (used at the showdown): sort your three values so that a <= b <= c.
- Prial (a = c): 300 + a. Exception: 3-3-3 scores 310.
- Run (b = a+1 and c = b+1): 200 + c. Exception: 1-2-3 scores 210. Runs do not wrap: 8-9-1 and 9-1-2 are not runs.
- Pair (a = b or b = c, but not a prial): 100 + 10 x the pair value + the odd card (for example 5-5-2 scores 152).
- High card (anything else): a + b + c (for example 2-5-9 scores 16).
Higher is better.

ROUNDS, LEADER AND DEALS: The game is played in rounds, at most 40. In each round every active player takes exactly one action, in clockwise order starting with that round's leader. Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

FORCED SHOWDOWN: If nobody has knocked, the showdown happens at the end of the round whose deal-round counter equals the number of active players plus 1: deal-round 4 when 3 players are active, deal-round 3 when 2 are active. There is no knocker.

SHOWDOWN (at the end of the round): All active hands are revealed and scored, and each score is announced and recorded as that player's last showdown score. If every active player has the same score, nobody loses a life. Otherwise every player with the lowest score loses 1 life, except a knocker with the lowest score, who loses 2 lives; a knocker who is not lowest loses nothing. Lives never go below 0; players at 0 lives are eliminated. The next round begins with a new deal and the deal-round counter at 1. If no showdown happened, the deal-round counter rises by 1 for the next round.

=== Knock Brag (3-player) ===

PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

DECK: 36 cards, 4 copies each of the values 1 to 9. There are no suits.

HAND SCORE (used at the showdown): sort your three values so that a <= b <= c.
- Prial (a = c): 300 + a. Exception: 3-3-3 scores 310.
- Run (b = a+1 and c = b+1): 200 + c. Exception: 1-2-3 scores 210. Runs do not wrap: 8-9-1 and 9-1-2 are not runs.

Higher is better.

ROUNDS, LEADER AND DEALS: The game is played in rounds, at most 40. In each round every active player takes exactly one action, in clockwise order starting with that round's leader. Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

ACTIONS: On your turn choose exactly one action, given as a single choice.
(a) TAKE UP (take_up_give_k): swap your card k for the face-up card U. The card you give becomes the new face-up U. Announced: 'Seat X took the face-up [value] and left a face-up [value]'.
(b) BLIND (blind_Dj_give_k): swap your card k for D1 or D2 without seeing it first. Your card goes face down into that slot; you now see the card you received. Announced: 'Seat X made a blind swap with Dj'; nobody else learns either card.
(c) WHOLE HAND (whole_hand_expose_k): take all three table cards into your hand. Your old three cards become the table hand: your old card k goes face up as U, the other two go face down into D1 and D2. Announced: 'Seat X swapped the whole hand and exposed a [value]'.
(d) KNOCK: keep your hand and make no exchange. Only the round's leader may knock, and only when the deal-round counter is 2 or more; knock is offered to nobody else, and not to the leader in deal-round 1. A knock is the knocker's action for that round. Announced: 'Seat X knocks'.

AFTER A KNOCK: The remaining active players in that same round (everyone after the knocker, clockwise) each take their action as normal, but must choose (a), (b) or (c). These are their final actions. The showdown then happens at the end of that round. If nobody knocks, play goes on.

FORCED SHOWDOWN: If nobody has knocked, the showdown happens at the end of the round whose deal-round counter equals the number of active players plus 1: deal-round 4 when 3 players are active, deal-round 3 when 2 are active. There is no knocker.

SHOWDOWN (at the end of the round): All active hands are revealed and scored, and each score is announced and recorded as that player's last showdown score. If every active player has the same score, nobody loses a life. Otherwise every player with the lowest score loses 1 life, except a knocker with the lowest score, who loses 2 lives; a knocker who is not lowest loses nothing. Lives never go below 0; players at 0 lives are eliminated. The next round begins with a new deal and the deal-round counter at 1. If no showdown happened, the deal-round counter rises by 1 for the next round.

END: The game ends at once when only one active player remains, and that player wins; or at the end of round 40, when the player with the most lives wins. records.system: You are one player in a game on the XColos platform, played by turns. You know only what the game tells you; other players' hidden information is hidden from you as yours is from them. Your goal is to win. Think about the rules, the other players and what they have done, then act. When you are asked to act, reply with exactly one legal answer in the form the question asks for, and keep any reasoning short and before the answer. Do not ask questions back.

[user]
=== Knock Brag (3-player) ===

PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

DECK: 36 cards, 4 copies each of the values 1 to 9. There are no suits.

HAND SCORE (used at the showdown): sort your three values so that a <= b <= c.
- Prial (a = c): 300 + a. Exception: 3-3-3 scores 310.
- Run (b = a+1 and c = b+1): 200 + c. Exception: 1-2-3 scores 210. Runs do not wrap: 8-9-1 and 9-1-2 are not runs.
- Pair (a = b or b = c, but not a prial): 100 + 10 x the pair value + the odd card (for example 5-5-2 scores 152).
- High card (anything else): a + b + c (for example 2-5-9 scores 16).
Higher is better.

ROUNDS, LEADER AND DEALS: The game is played in rounds, at most 40. In each round every active player takes exactly one action, in clockwise order starting with that round's leader. Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

ACTIONS: On your turn choose exactly one action, given as a single choice.
(a) TAKE UP (take_up_give_k): swap your card k for the face-up card U. The card you give becomes the new face-up U. Announced: 'Seat X took the face-up [value] and left a face-up [value]'.
(b) BLIND (blind_Dj_give_k): swap your card k for D1 or D2 without seeing it first. Your card goes face down into that slot; you now see the card you received. Announced: 'Seat X made a blind swap with Dj'; nobody else learns either card.
(c) WHOLE HAND (whole_hand_expose_k): take all three table cards into your hand. Your old three cards become the table hand: your old card k goes face up as U, the other two go face down into D1 and D2. Announced: 'Seat X swapped the whole hand and exposed a [value]'.
(d) KNOCK: keep your hand and make no exchange. Only the round's leader may knock, and only when the deal-round counter is 2 or more; knock is offered to nobody else, and not to the leader in deal-round 1. A knock is the knocker's action for that round. Announced: 'Seat X knocks'.

AFTER A KNOCK: The remaining active players in that same round (everyone after the knocker, clockwise) each take their action as normal, but must choose (a), (b) or (c). These are their final actions. The showdown then happens at the end of that round. If nobody knocks, play goes on.

FORCED SHOWDOWN: If nobody has knocked, the showdown happens at the end of the round whose deal-round counter equals the number of active players plus 1: deal-round 4 when 3 players are active, deal-round 3 when 2 are active. There is no knocker.

SHOWDOWN (at the end of the round): All active hands are revealed and scored, and each score is announced and recorded as that player's last showdown score. If every active player has the same score, nobody loses a life. Otherwise every player with the lowest score loses 1 life, except a knocker with the lowest score, who loses 2 lives; a knocker who is not lowest loses nothing. Lives never go below 0; players at 0 lives are eliminated. The next round begins with a new deal and the deal-round counter at 1. If no showdown happened, the deal-round counter rises by 1 for the next round.

END: The game ends at once when only one active player remains, and that player wins; or at the end of round 40, when the player with the most lives wins. A tie on lives is broken by the higher last showdown score among the tied players; if they are still tied, or no showdown has happened, the tied players share the win (a draw).

[user]
=== Knock Brag (3-player) ===

PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

DECK: 36 cards, 4 copies each of the values 1 to 9. There are no suits.

HAND SCORE (used at the showdown): sort your three values so that a <= b <= c.
- Prial (a = c): 300 + a. Exception: 3-3-3 scores 310.
- Run (b = a+1 and c = b+1): 200 + c. Exception: 1-2-3 scores 210. Runs do not wrap: 8-9-1 and 9-1-2 are not runs.

Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

records.system: You are one player in a game on the XColos platform, played by turns. You know only what the game tells you; other players' hidden information is hidden from you as yours is from them. Your goal is to win. Think about the rules, the other players and what they have done, then act. When you are asked to act, reply with exactly one legal answer in the form the question asks for, and keep any reasoning short and before the answer. Do not ask questions back.

[user]
=== Knock Brag (3-player) ===

PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

DECK: 36 cards, 4 copies each of the values 1 to 9. There are no suits.

HAND SCORE (used at the showdown): sort your three values so that a <= b <= c.
- Prial (a = c): 300 + a. Exception: 3-3-3 scores 310.
- Run (b = a+1 and c = b+1): 200 + c. Exception: 1-2-3 scores 210. Runs do not wrap: 8-9-1 and 9-1-2 are not runs.
- Pair (a = b or b = c, but not a prial): 100 + 10 x the pair value + the odd card (for example 5-5-2 scores 152).
- High card (anything else): a + b + c (for example 2-5-9 scores 16).
Higher is better.

ROUNDS, LEADER AND DEALS: The game is played in rounds, at most 40. In each round every active player takes exactly one action, in clockwise order starting with that round's leader. Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

ACTIONS: On your turn choose exactly one action, given as a single choice.
(a) TAKE UP (take_up_give_k): swap your card k for the face-up card U. The card you give becomes the new face-up U. Announced: 'Seat X took the face-up [value] and left a face-up [value]'.
(b) BLIND (blind_Dj_give_k): swap your card k for D1 or D2 without seeing it first. Your card goes face down into that slot; you now see the card you received. Announced: 'Seat X made a blind swap with Dj'; nobody else learns either card.
(c) WHOLE HAND (whole_hand_expose_k): take all three table cards into your hand. Your old three cards become the table hand: your old card k goes face up as U, the other two go face down into D1 and D2. Announced: 'Seat X swapped the whole hand and exposed a [value]'.
(d) KNOCK: keep your hand and make no exchange. Only the round's leader may knock, and only when the deal-round counter is 2 or more; knock is offered to nobody else, and not to the leader in deal-round 1. A knock is the knocker's action for that round. Announced: 'Seat X knocks'.

AFTER A KNOCK: The remaining active players in that same round (everyone after the knocker, clockwise) each take their action as normal, but must choose (a), (b) or (c). These are their final actions. The showdown then happens at the end of that round. If nobody knocks, play goes on.

FORCED SHOWDOWN: If nobody has knocked, the showdown happens at the end of the round whose deal-round counter equals the number of active players plus 1: deal-round 4 when 3 players are active, deal-round 3 when 2 are active. There is no knocker.

SHOWDOWN (at the end of the round): All active hands are revealed and scored, and each score is announced and recorded as that player's last showdown score. If every active player has the same score, nobody loses a life. Otherwise every player with the lowest score loses 1 life, except a knocker with the lowest score, who loses 2 lives; a knocker who is not lowest loses nothing. Lives never go below 0; players at 0 lives are eliminated. The next round begins with a new deal and the deal-round counter at 1. If no showdown happened, the deal-round counter rises by 1 for the next round.

END: The game ends at once when only one active player remains, and that player wins; or at the end of round 40, when the player with the most lives wins. A tie on lives is broken by the higher last showdown score among the tied players; if they are still tied, or no showdown has happened, the tied players share the win (a draw).

records.prompt:
[user]
=== Knock Brag (3-player) ===

PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

DECK: 36 cards, 4 copies each of the values 1 to 9. There are no suits.

HAND SCORE (used at the showdown): sort your three values so that a <= b <= c.
- Prial (a = c): 300 + a. Exception: 3-3-3 scores 310.
- Run (b = a+1 and c = b+1): 200 + c. Exception: 1-2-3 scores 210. Runs do not wrap: 8-9-1 and 9-1-2 are not runs.
- Pair (a = b or b = c, but not a prial): 100 + 10 x the pair value + the odd card (for example 5-5-2 scores 152).
- High card (anything else): a + b + c (for example 2-5-9 scores 16).
Higher is better.

ROUNDS, LEADER AND DEALS: The game is played in rounds, at most 40. In each round every active player takes exactly one action, in clockwise order starting with that round's leader. Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

ACTIONS: On your turn choose exactly one action, given as a single choice.
(a) TAKE UP (take_up_give_k): swap your card k for the face-up card U. The card you give becomes the new face-up U. Announced: 'Seat X took the face-up [value] and left a face-up [value]'.
(b) BLIND (blind_Dj_give_k): swap your card k for D1 or D2 without seeing it first. Your card goes face down into that slot; you now see the card you received. Announced: 'Seat X made a blind swap with Dj'; nobody else learns either card.
(c) WHOLE HAND (whole_hand_expose_k): take all three table cards into your hand. Your old three cards become the table hand: your old card k goes face up as U, the other two go face down into D1 and D2. Announced: 'Seat X swapped the whole hand and exposed a [value]'.
(d) KNOCK: keep your hand and make no exchange. Only the round's leader may knock, and only when the deal-round counter is 2 or more; knock is offered to nobody else, and not to the leader in deal-round 1. A knock is the knocker's action for that round. Announced: 'Seat X knocks'.

AFTER A KNOCK: The remaining active players in that same round (everyone after the knocker, clockwise) each take their action as normal, but must choose (a), (b) or (c). These are their final actions. The showdown then happens at the end of that round. If nobody knocks, play goes on.

FORCED SHOWDOWN: If nobody has knocked, the showdown happens at the end of the round whose deal-round counter equals the number of active players plus 1: deal-round 4 when 3 players are active, deal-round 3 when 2 are active. There is no knocker.

PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

Higher is better.

ROUNDS, LEADER AND DEALS: The game is played in rounds, at most 40. In each round every active player takes exactly one action, in clockwise order starting with that round's leader. Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

ACTIONS: On your turn choose exactly one action, given as a single choice.

(c) WHOLE HAND (whole_hand_expose_k): take all three table cards into your hand. Your old three cards become the table hand: your old card k goes face up as U, the other two go face down into D1 and D2. Announced: 'Seat X swapped the whole hand and exposed a [value]'.
(d) KNOCK: keep your hand and make no exchange. Only the round's leader may knock, and only when the deal-round counter is 2 or more; knock is offered to nobody else, and not to the leader in deal-round 1. A knock is the knocker's action for that round. Announced: 'Seat X knocks'.

If every active player has the same score, nobody loses a life. Otherwise every player with the lowest score loses 1 life, except a knocker with the lowest score, who loses 2 lives; a knocker who is not lowest loses nothing. [user]
=== Knock Brag (3-player) ===

PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

DECK: 36 cards, 4 copies each of the values 1 to 9. There are no suits.

HAND SCORE (used at the showdown): sort your three values so that a <= b <= c.
- Prial (a = c): 300 + a. Exception: 3-3-3 scores 310.
- Run (b = a+1 and c = b+1): 200 + c. Exception: 1-2-3 scores 210. Runs do not wrap: 8-9-1 and 9-1-2 are not runs.
- Pair (a = b or b = c, but not a prial): 100 + 10 x the pair value + the odd card (for example 5-5-2 scores 152).
- High card (anything else): a + b + c (for example 2-5-9 scores 16).
Higher is better.

ROUNDS, LEADER AND DEALS: The game is played in rounds, at most 40. In each round every active player takes exactly one action, in clockwise order starting with that round's leader. Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

ACTIONS: On your turn choose exactly one action, given as a single choice.
(a) TAKE UP (take_up_give_k): swap your card k for the face-up card U. The card you give becomes the new face-up U. Announced: 'Seat X took the face-up [value] and left a face-up [value]'.
(b) BLIND (blind_Dj_give_k): swap your card k for D1 or D2 without seeing it first. Your card goes face down into that slot; you now see the card you received. Announced: 'Seat X made a blind swap with Dj'; nobody else learns either card.
(c) WHOLE HAND (whole_hand_expose_k): take all three table cards into your hand. Your old three cards become the table hand: your old card k goes face up as U, the other two go face down into D1 and D2. Announced: 'Seat X swapped the whole hand and exposed a [value]'.
(d) KNOCK: keep your hand and make no exchange. Only the round's leader may knock, and only when the deal-round counter is 2 or more; knock is offered to nobody else, and not to the leader in deal-round 1. A knock is the knocker's action for that round. Announced: 'Seat X knocks'.

AFTER A KNOCK: The remaining active players in that same round (everyone after the knocker, clockwise) each take their action as normal, but must choose (a), (b) or (c). These are their final actions. The showdown then happens at the end of that round. If nobody knocks, play goes on.

FORCED SHOWDOWN: If nobody has knocked, the showdown happens at the end of the round whose deal-round counter equals the number of active players plus 1: deal-round 4 when 3 players are active, deal-round 3 when 2 are active. There is no knocker.

SHOWDOWN (at the end of the round): All active hands are revealed and scored, and each score is announced and recorded as that player's last showdown score. If every active player has the same score, nobody loses a life. Otherwise every player with the lowest score loses 1 life, except a knocker with the lowest score, who loses 2 lives; a knocker who is not lowest loses nothing. Lives never go below 0; players at 0 lives are eliminated. The next round begins with a new deal and the deal-round counter at 1. If no showdown happened, the deal-round counter rises by 1 for the next round.

END: The game ends at once when only one active player remains, and that player wins; or at the end of round 40, when the player with the most lives wins. A tie on lives is broken by the higher last showdown score among the tied players; if they are still tied, or no showdown has happened, the tied players share the win (a draw).

[user]
=== Knock Brag (3-player) ===

PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

DECK: 36 cards, 4 copies each of the values 1 to 9. There are no suits.

HAND SCORE (used at the showdown): sort your three values so that a <= b <= c.
- Prial (a = c): 300 + a. Exception: 3-3-3 scores 310.
- Run (b = a+1 and c = b+1): 200 + c. Exception: 1-2-3 scores 210. Runs do not wrap: 8-9-1 and 9-1-2 are not runs.
- Pair (a = b or b = c, but not a prial): 100 + 10 x the pair value + the odd card (for example 5-5-2 scores 152).
- High card (anything else): a + b + c (for example 2-5-9 scores 16).
Higher is better.

ROUNDS, LEADER AND DEALS: The game is played in rounds, at most 40. In each round every active player takes exactly one action, in clockwise order starting with that round's leader. Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

ACTIONS: On your turn choose exactly one action, given as a single choice.
(a) TAKE UP (take_up_give_k): swap your card k for the face-up card U. The card you give becomes the new face-up U. Announced: 'Seat X took the face-up [value] and left a face-up [value]'.
(b) BLIND (blind_Dj_give_k): swap your card k for D1 or D2 without seeing it first. Your card goes face down into that slot; you now see the card you received. Announced: 'Seat X made a blind swap with Dj'; nobody else learns either card.
(c) WHOLE HAND (whole_hand_expose_k): take all three table cards into your hand. Your old three cards become the table hand: your old card k goes face up as U, the other two go face down into D1 and D2. Announced: 'Seat X swapped the whole hand and exposed a [value]'.
(d) KNOCK: keep your hand and make no exchange. Only the round's leader may knock, and only when the deal-round counter is 2 or more; knock is offered to nobody else, and not to the leader in deal-round 1. A knock is the knocker's action for that round. Announced: 'Seat X knocks'.

AFTER A KNOCK: The remaining active players in that same round (everyone after the knocker, clockwise) each take their action as normal, but must choose (a), (b) or (c). These are their final actions. The showdown then happens at the end of that round. If nobody knocks, play goes on.

FORCED SHOWDOWN: If nobody has knocked, the showdown happens at the end of the round whose deal-round counter equals the number of active players plus 1: deal-round 4 when 3 players are active, deal-round 3 when 2 are active. There is no knocker.

SHOWDOWN (at the end of the round): All active hands are revealed and scored, and each score is announced and recorded as that player's last showdown score. If every active player has the same score, nobody loses a life. Otherwise every player with the lowest score loses 1 life, except a knocker with the lowest score, who loses 2 lives; a knocker who is not lowest loses nothing. Lives never go below 0; players at 0 lives are eliminated. The next round begins with a new deal and the deal-round counter at 1. If no showdown happened, the deal-round counter rises by 1 for the next round.

END: The game ends at once when only one active player remains, and that player wins; or at the end of round 40, when the player with the most lives wins. A tie on lives is broken by the higher last showdown score among the tied players; if they are still tied, or no showdown has happened, the tied players share the win (a draw).

=== Knock Brag (3-player) ===

PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

DECK: 36 cards, 4 copies each of the values 1 to 9. There are no suits.

HAND SCORE (used at the showdown): sort your three values so that a <= b <= c.
- Prial (a = c): 300 + a. Exception: 3-3-3 scores 310.
- Run (b = a+1 and c = b+1): 200 + c. Exception: 1-2-3 scores 210. Runs do not wrap: 8-9-1 and 9-1-2 are not runs.
- Pair (a = b or b = c, but not a prial): 100 + 10 x the pair value + the odd card (for example 5-5-2 scores 152).

Higher is better.

ROUNDS, LEADER AND DEALS: The game is played in rounds, at most 40. In each round every active player takes exactly one action, in clockwise order starting with that round's leader. Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

ACTIONS: On your turn choose exactly one action, given as a single choice.
(a) TAKE UP (take_up_give_k): swap your card k for the face-up card U. The card you give becomes the new face-up U. Announced: 'Seat X took the face-up [value] and left a face-up [value]'.
(b) BLIND (blind_Dj_give_k): swap your card k for D1 or D2 without seeing it first. Your card goes face down into that slot; you now see the card you received. Announced: 'Seat X made a blind swap with Dj'; nobody else learns either card.
(c) WHOLE HAND (whole_hand_expose_k): take all three table cards into your hand. Your old three cards become the table hand: your old card k goes face up as U, the other two go face down into D1 and D2. Announced: 'Seat X swapped the whole hand and exposed a [value]'.
(d) KNOCK: keep your hand and make no exchange. Only the round's leader may knock, and only when the deal-round counter is 2 or more; knock is offered to nobody else, and not to the leader in deal-round 1. A knock is the knocker's action for that round. Announced: 'Seat X knocks'.

AFTER A KNOCK: The remaining active players in that same round (everyone after the knocker, clockwise) each take their action as normal, but must choose (a), (b) or (c). These are their final actions. The showdown then happens at the end of that round. If nobody knocks, play goes on.

FORCED SHOWDOWN: If nobody has knocked, the showdown happens at the end of the round whose deal-round counter equals the number of active players plus 1: deal-round 4 when 3 players are active, deal-round 3 when 2 are active. There is no knocker.

SHOWDOWN (at the end of the round): All active hands are revealed and scored, and each score is announced and recorded as that player's last showdown score. If every active player has the same score, nobody loses a life. Otherwise every player with the lowest score loses 1 life, except a knocker with the lowest score, who loses 2 lives; a knocker who is not lowest loses nothing. Lives never go below 0; players at 0 lives are eliminated. The next round begins with a new deal and the deal-round counter at 1. If no showdown happened, the deal-round counter rises by 1 for the next round.

END: The game ends at once when only one active player remains, and that player wins; or at the end of round 40, when the player with the most lives wins. records.prompt:
[user]
=== Knock Brag (3-player) ===

PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

DECK: 36 cards, 4 copies each of the values 1 to 9. There are no suits.

HAND SCORE (used at the showdown): sort your three values so that a <= b <= c.
- Prial (a = c): 300 + a. Exception: 3-3-3 scores 310.
- Run (b = a+1 and c = b+1): 200 + c. Exception: 1-2-3 scores 210. Runs do not wrap: 8-9-1 and 9-1-2 are not runs.
- Pair (a = b or b = c, but not a prial): 100 + 10 x the pair value + the odd card (for example 5-5-2 scores 152).
- High card (anything else): a + b + c (for example 2-5-9 scores 16).
Higher is better.

ROUNDS, LEADER AND DEALS: The game is played in rounds, at most 40. In each round every active player takes exactly one action, in clockwise order starting with that round's leader. Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

ACTIONS: On your turn choose exactly one action, given as a single choice.
(a) TAKE UP (take_up_give_k): swap your card k for the face-up card U. The card you give becomes the new face-up U. Announced: 'Seat X took the face-up [value] and left a face-up [value]'.
(b) BLIND (blind_Dj_give_k): swap your card k for D1 or D2 without seeing it first. Your card goes face down into that slot; you now see the card you received. Announced: 'Seat X made a blind swap with Dj'; nobody else learns either card.
(c) WHOLE HAND (whole_hand_expose_k): take all three table cards into your hand. Your old three cards become the table hand: your old card k goes face up as U, the other two go face down into D1 and D2. Announced: 'Seat X swapped the whole hand and exposed a [value]'.
(d) KNOCK: keep your hand and make no exchange. Only the round's leader may knock, and only when the deal-round counter is 2 or more; knock is offered to nobody else, and not to the leader in deal-round 1. A knock is the knocker's action for that round. Announced: 'Seat X knocks'.

AFTER A KNOCK: The remaining active players in that same round (everyone after the knocker, clockwise) each take their action as normal, but must choose (a), (b) or (c). These are their final actions. The showdown then happens at the end of that round. If nobody knocks, play goes on.

FORCED SHOWDOWN: If nobody has knocked, the showdown happens at the end of the round whose deal-round counter equals the number of active players plus 1: deal-round 4 when 3 players are active, deal-round 3 when 2 are active. There is no knocker.

SHOWDOWN (at the end of the round): All active hands are revealed and scored, and each score is announced and recorded as that player's last showdown score. If every active player has the same score, nobody loses a life. Otherwise every player with the lowest score loses 1 life, except a knocker with the lowest score, who loses 2 lives; a knocker who is not lowest loses nothing. Lives never go below 0; players at 0 lives are eliminated. The next round begins with a new deal and the deal-round counter at 1. First, a summary of the whole game as it unfolded: the turning points, the moves that decided it, and how it ended. Concrete: name seats, rounds and numbers.

Second, a review of each player. Judge their play, not their luck. For each one, compare their predictions with what their opponents were actually thinking and actually did: were they right, and did they see it in time? Did their adjustments follow from their predictions, and did their moves follow from their reasons? Point out their best and worst moves. Then score their play from 1 to 10, where 1 is aimless or self-defeating and 10 is sharp, well read and well executed. A player can lose and still score well, or win and score badly.

A player who gave no reasons, predictions or adjustments is judged on their moves alone; say that their thinking was not recorded.

Refer to each player by seat, and as "they".

THE GAME
PLAYERS AND LIVES: 3 players in seats 1, 2 and 3, clockwise. Each starts with 3 lives. A player at 0 lives is eliminated and takes no further part; the others are active.

DECK: 36 cards, 4 copies each of the values 1 to 9. There are no suits.

HAND SCORE (used at the showdown): sort your three values so that a <= b <= c.
- Prial (a = c): 300 + a. Exception: 3-3-3 scores 310.
- Run (b = a+1 and c = b+1): 200 + c. Exception: 1-2-3 scores 210. Runs do not wrap: 8-9-1 and 9-1-2 are not runs.
- Pair (a = b or b = c, but not a prial): 100 + 10 x the pair value + the odd card (for example 5-5-2 scores 152).
- High card (anything else): a + b + c (for example 2-5-9 scores 16).
Higher is better.

ROUNDS, LEADER AND DEALS: The game is played in rounds, at most 40. In each round every active player takes exactly one action, in clockwise order starting with that round's leader. Seat 1 leads round 1. In each later round the leader is the next active player clockwise from the previous round's leader; this continues across deals and skips eliminated players. A deal is the series of rounds from one dealing to its showdown; the deal-round counter is 1 in the first round of a deal, 2 in the second, and so on.

DEALING: At the start of round 1, and of every round that follows a showdown, the 36 cards are shuffled. Each active player receives 3 cards face down that only they see. 3 cards go to the table: slot U face up, seen by everyone, and slots D1 and D2 face down, seen by nobody. The value of U is announced. The rest of the deck is not used in that deal.

ACTIONS: On your turn choose exactly one action, given as a single choice.
(a) TAKE UP (take_up_give_k): swap your card k for the face-up card U. The card you give becomes the new face-up U. Announced: 'Seat X took the face-up [value] and left a face-up [value]'.
(b) BLIND (blind_Dj_give_k): swap your card k for D1 or D2 without seeing it first. Your card goes face down into that slot; you now see the card you received. Announced: 'Seat X made a blind swap with Dj'; nobody else learns either card.
(c) WHOLE HAND (whole_hand_expose_k): take all three table cards into your hand. Your old three cards become the table hand: your old card k goes face up as U, the other two go face down into D1 and D2. Announced: 'Seat X swapped the whole hand and exposed a [value]'.
(d) KNOCK: keep your hand and make no exchange. Only the round's leader may knock, and only when the deal-round counter is 2 or more; knock is offered to nobody else, and not to the leader in deal-round 1. A knock is the knocker's action for that round. Announced: 'Seat X knocks'.

AFTER A KNOCK: The remaining active players in that same round (everyone after the knocker, clockwise) each take their action as normal, but must choose (a), (b) or (c). These are their final actions. The showdown then happens at the end of that round. If nobody knocks, play goes on.

FORCED SHOWDOWN: If nobody has knocked, the showdown happens at the end of the round whose deal-round counter equals the number of active players plus 1: deal-round 4 when 3 players are active, deal-round 3 when 2 are active. There is no knocker.

SHOWDOWN (at the end of the round): All active hands are revealed and scored, and each score is announced and recorded as that player's last showdown score. If every active player has the same score, nobody loses a life. Otherwise every player with the lowest score loses 1 life, except a knocker with the lowest score, who loses 2 lives; a knocker who is not lowest loses nothing. Lives never go below 0; players at 0 lives are eliminated. The next round begins with a new deal and the deal-round counter at 1. If no showdown happened, the deal-round counter rises by 1 for the next round.

END: The game ends at once when only one active player remains, and that player wins; or at the end of round 40, when the player with the most lives wins. A tie on lives is broken by the higher last showdown score among the tied players; if they are still tied, or no showdown has happened, the tied players share the win (a draw).
